description: Source code for the SequentialThinking_MCP class implementing an INode interface, providing a tool for structured problem-solving via MCP server integration.

classes.name: SequentialThinking_MCP
classes.description: A class implementing INode, providing methods to load tools, initialize, and interact with MCP server for sequential thinking.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains method listActions to asynchronously list available actions from the MCP toolkit.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, filters tools based on MCP actions specified in nodeData.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Fetches tools from MCP server using getNodeModulesPackagePath and MCPToolkit.
